budget.description: Approximate token budget; lowest-confidence hits drop first.

session_id.description: Id of a capture session started with start_capture.

show_values.description: Show raw captured values instead of redacting them.

tap.description: Path to a .tap capture file (inside the sandbox root).

values.description: Known values (email, ad-id, GPS fix, free string, ...) to search for across decoded traffic: {value, kind, label} objects or VALUE / KIND=VALUE strings.

kind.description: How to normalize it before searching. Canonical kinds: aaid, android_id, email, free, gps, imei, ip, phone. Aliases: advertising_id/idfa/gaid/adid/idfv -> aaid; geo/geolocation/location -> gps.

label.description: A name for this canary in the results.

value.description: The exact value to trace (never logged).

anyOf.description: Shorthand: VALUE (kind free) or KIND=VALUE (e.g. email=alice@example.com), labelled <kind>-<n>.
